name: script generator typing out a hook line
looks: A dark rounded panel pops in with a set of mode tabs across the top, then a script document types itself on below, line by line, in mono type, finishing on a short opening hook line that stays highlighted as the payoff.
build: The terminal-type-on mechanic: DOM text revealed per character at a steady rate with a blinking block cursor; the panel scales/pops in before typing starts (0.9 -> 1, power3.out); the final hook line gets a subtle highlight once typing completes.
sound: A soft mechanical key tick per character, a single confirm tone on the finished line.
prompt: Pop in a dark, rounded document panel with a few mode tabs across the top, then type a short script onto it character by character in mono type with a blinking cursor, finishing on one highlighted opening line as the shot's payoff, ready to use.
